newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore, Brunei say no plan to end currency link.
newsitem.headline: Singapore, Brunei say no plan to end currency link.

text.p: Singapore and Brunei said in a joint statement on Monday they had no intention of ending their currency interchangeability agreement, under which the Brunei dollar is pegged to the Singapore dollar.

It said market speculation in recent months that Brunei might abandon its currency peg with the Singapore dollar could have caused some uncertainty or led observers to question the good working relationship between both countries' currency boards.
"The governments of Brunei and Singapore wish to dispel such rumours and state clearly and categorically, that we have no intention of terminating the currency interchangeability agreement," it said.
Market rumours about a possible de-linking of the Brunei dollar surfaced late last month amid talk Brunei might withdraw from the agreement in an effort to make its non-oil exports more competitive.
